9. Complete cost and fair comparison

The financial basis is:

Introduced production volume: 100 cells/year, development amortized over 500.
Principal finance case: 10 years, 8% real discount.
A separate 20-year sensitivity retains component replacements.
4,000 scheduled hours/year, with 90% introduced unplanned availability, followed by scheduled maintenance deductions.
Paid industrial space, installation, calibration, preparation, disposal and retirement.
All 450 destroyed wafers restored economically, including those initially installed on rejected spares.

The repeat cell and first-build estimates are:

Item	Estimate
Repeat installed cell	$491,921
First complete full-size build	$1,070,841
Smaller automated loaded-bay build	$311,960
Separate smaller experiment campaign	$12,856

Most integrated-machine and custom-part prices are introduced estimates. The report itemizes stock, machining, heat treatment, instrumentation, assembly, calibration, yield and factory overhead.

A prepared cartridge is approximately $442, and a wafer $11.26. Finite replacement entries include guides, drives, hoses, pumps, sensors, electronics, dies, latches, saddles, oil and depot wear. The finance horizon is not assigned as their life.

The complete modeled service/reset costs are:

Implementation	Cost per cycle	In-window human intervention	All paid operational human time
Candidate	$13,025	0 h modeled	10.883 h
Competent unattended cell with the same interfaces and recovery construction	$13,025	0 h modeled	10.883 h
Same-hardware human-assisted cell	$13,057	0.5 h introduced	11.269 h
Competent manual challenge: 20 h service + 8 h reset	$11,678	20 h introduced	35.191 h

The manual timing is independently estimated, rather than scaled from robot duration. Its 12- and 32-hour service sensitivities, each with paid reset, cost approximately $11,072 and $12,590.

The candidate’s main per-cycle costs are:

Cost category	Per modeled cycle
Parts and consumables	$8,134
Capital recovery	$2,417
Finite replacements	$1,644
Calibration, cleaning and software	$277
Paid floor	$253
Preparation/replenishment labor	$238
Remaining site, oil, retirement and electricity entries	About $62

At 2,000 scheduled hours/year, candidate cost rises to about $16,416. Twenty-year finance reduces it to about $12,383, while retaining finite replacements.
